src/sqllens/_bounded_json.py:60-62 rejects an int only if bit_length() > remaining_bytes*4. This is a cheap pre-filter, since decimal digits are about 0.301*bits, so it does not over-reject. It runs before json.dumps, so a huge int is never converted. An int that passes but is still too long fails at line 66: charge() raises JsonBoundsError when the budget goes negative. An int over CPython's 4300-digit str limit makes json.dumps raise ValueError, which line 67 catches and re-raises as JsonBoundsError.
